_doc: Analyst-attached, verified evidence for Command Brief items whose collected article does not report the item's subject directly. Version-controlled and dated: each source was opened and checked on 'verified_on'. Matching: an entry applies to a development when its country is in match.country_ids, its title/fact matches match.subject_rx, and the report period end falls inside match.period_end_between. Publications restating one statement share one lineage_key (one piece of evidence, not several). 'published' is the publication date of that page, never an event date.
